description_en: Creates a TensorBoard by using a job or specifying a data source configuration
description_zh: 创建一个Tensorboard，可以通过一个任务或者指定数据源配置来创建
kebab_example: aliyun pai-dlc create-tensorboard --workspace-id 123000 --job-id dlc-20210126170216-mtl37ge7gkvdz --data-source-id d-xxxxxxxx --data-source-type OSS --uri oss://.oss-cn-shanghai-finance-1.aliyuncs.com/ --options '{"mountpath":"/root/data/"}' --summary-path /root/data/ --summary-relative-path /summary/ --display-name tensorboard --source-type job --source-id dlc-xxxxxx --max-running-time-minutes 240 --data-sources Path=oss://mybucket/path/to/dir MountPath=/root/data/ Options={"key":"value"} Description=data_source_of_dlc_examples Endpoint=oss-cn-beijing-internal.aliyuncs.com GmtModifyTime=2021-01-12T14:36:00Z UserId=123456789 DataSourceType=NAS DisplayName=nas-data FileSystemId=1ca4040000 DataSourceId=data-20210114104214-xxxxxxx GmtCreateTime=2021-01-12T14:35:00Z --cpu 1 --memory 1000 --tensorboard-data-sources SummaryPath=/tensorboard/run1 DataSourceType=OSS SourceType=datasource Id=d-vf2fdhxxxxxx DirectoryName=dlcJobName Uri=oss://examplebucket.oss-cn-shanghai-internal.aliyuncs.com/ FullSummaryPath=oss://xxxxx/tensorboard/run1 Name=dlcJobName --tensorboard-spec VpcId=vpc-xxxx EcsType=ecs.g6.large SecurityGroupId=sg-xxxxx SwitchId=vsw-xxxx --quota-id quota12345 --priority 1 --accessibility PRIVATE --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTensorboard

parameters.help_en:
The priority of the job. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 9.

1 is the lowest priority.
9 is the highest priority
parameters.help_zh:
任务的优先级，可选参数，默认值 1，参数值的范围是 1~9。其中：
1为最低优先级。
9为最高优先级
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en:

资源配额ID。使用资源配额的资源创建Tensorboard任务时的必填参数。<props="china">如何获取资源配额ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2628071.html。</props>
